snippet.title: Honeycomb: The World Beyond - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The journey to Sota7 is about to begin! Honeycomb: The World Beyond officially launches on September 8. Dive into a vibrant alien ecosystem where bioengineering meets survival. Explore diverse biomes, build your perfect modular base, and discover fascinating species of flora and fauna.

Want to start your research early? The official Demo goes live on August 31, giving you the perfect opportunity to experience the early-game mechanics, gather resources, and craft your first laboratory.

Wishlist the game and prepare for the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb_The_World_Beyond/
